speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise; to better assess your condition, how many weeks pregnant are you and when did these symptoms first begin?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is a very specific detail about the ice cream; was it homemade, or did you buy it from a store? Also, have you noticed any rash on your body, and does your headache feel like a severe pressure behind your eyes?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (Listeria monocytogenes infection).

The specific detail of consuming ice cream three days prior to the onset of fever, headache, anorexia, and fatigue in a third-trimester pregnant patient is highly suggestive of Listeria monocytogenes infection. I will now proceed with confirmation.
